title: Entity Trail
description: Causes an entity to leave a trail of blocks as it moves about the world. Obeys Mob Griefing rules.

block_type.title: Block Type
block_type.description: The type of block that is spawned as a trail behind the entity. Solid blocks cannot be spawned at an offset of (0, 0, 0).

force_replace_matched_blocks.title: Force Replace Matched Blocks
force_replace_matched_blocks.description: When true, the trail will replace blocks that match the replaceable blocks list even if normal placement rules prevent it.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: When provided, the trail spawns blocks across a (2 * radius + 1) by (2 * radius + 1) horizontal area centered on the spawn offset. Uses the legacy four-corner sampling when omitted.

replaceable_blocks.description: A list of blocks that can be replaced by the trail block. If the block at the spawn offset is not in this list, the trail block will not spawn. If omitted it will default to only air blocks.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

spawn_filter.title: Spawn Filter
spawn_filter.description: One or more conditions that must be met in order to cause the chosen block type to spawn.

defaultSnippets.label: Spawn Offset (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Spawn Offset as an object

spawn_offset.title: Spawn Offset
spawn_offset.description: The offset from the entity's current position at which to spawn the block, capped at 16 blocks away.

defaultSnippets.label: Spawn Offset (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Spawn Offset as an object
